lambdynlights.menu.canvas.1: 推薦在使用「Canvas」模組時，停用實體動態照明！
lambdynlights.menu.canvas.2: 動態照明目前與「Canvas」一起使用會有嚴重的效能使用！
lambdynlights.menu.support_me.tooltip: Like the mod? You can support me so I can continue to deliver high-quality mods!
lambdynlights.menu.tabs.debug.descriptio: For modders, in case of tricky bugs.
lambdynlights.menu.tabs.dynamic_lights.e: Below, you can disable light produced by any entity. You may find entities that wouldn't normally produce lights with only %s installed - they are here in case another mod or resource pack adds dynamic lighting to them. You may safely ignore them.

Search for an entity.
You can search by namespace by prefixing with %s (such as %s).
You can search which entities have lighting enabled or disabled by using the keywords %s and %s.
lambdynlights.menu.title: %s Settings
lambdynlights.option.adaptive_ticking.sl: Light sources at least that many chunks away from the camera will be refreshed less often. We recommend to set it to about 5 chunks.
Light sources at least that many chunks away from the camera will be refreshed even less often. We recommend to set it to about 8 chunks.
lambdynlights.option.adaptive_ticking.ba: Adaptive Ticking for Light Sources Behind
Makes light sources behind the camera refresh less often (recommended).
lambdynlights.option.chunk_rebuild_sched:
Defines how the mod rebuilds chunks.
• %s (recommended): Chunks are rebuilt only when deemed necessary. May cause extremely rare visual glitches.
• %s: Chunks are rebuilt as soon as dynamic lights are updated. May cause worse performances.
Changes to this setting will only take effect after saving and quitting.
lambdynlights.option.debug.active_dynami: Show in the world every currently active cells in the dynamic lighting engine.
lambdynlights.option.debug.cell_display_: Display Radius of Dynamic Lighting Cells
lambdynlights.option.debug.display_behav: Display Dynamic Light Behavior Bounding Box
Show in the world the bounding box of dynamic light behaviors.
lambdynlights.option.debug.display_dynam: Show in the world every chunk rebuilds caused by dynamic lighting updates.
lambdynlights.option.debug.light_level_r: Display Radius of Dynamic Light Level
Enables the dynamic lighting of Beacon or End Gateway beams. They should rarely update.
lambdynlights.option.light_sources.firef: Enables the dynamic lighting of firefly particles emitted by Firefly Bushes.
lambdynlights.option.light_sources.glowi: Enables the dynamic lighting of entities that have the Glowing effect.
lambdynlights.option.light_sources.guard: Enables the dynamic lighting of the lasers shot by Guardians.
lambdynlights.option.light_sources.sonic: Enables the dynamic lighting of the Warden's sonic boom attack particles.
lambdynlights.tooltip.block_entities: 啟用方塊實體動態照明。
lambdynlights.tooltip.creeper_lighting:
Sets the dynamic lighting mode for Creepers.
• %s disables Creeper dynamic lighting.
• %s sets a constant luminance.
• %s sets a dynamic luminance.
lambdynlights.tooltip.entities: Enables entities dynamic lighting. Note: it's always active for players.
lambdynlights.tooltip.mode.1: Enables dynamic lights. For example, if enabled, a torch held by a player will light up the area.
lambdynlights.tooltip.mode.2: %s 和 %s 會使光源繪製稍微延遲，但能夠最大限度地減少照明更新。
lambdynlights.tooltip.self_light_source: 啟用第一人稱動態照明。若你使用的光影已經擁有動態照明功能，那麼建議你將本功能停用。
lambdynlights.tooltip.tnt_lighting:
Sets the dynamic lighting mode for TNT.
• %s disables TNT dynamic lighting.
• %s sets a constant luminance.
• %s sets a dynamic luminance.
lambdynlights.tooltip.water_sensitive: Enables the check for water-sensitive light sources. This means that some items will not emit light while being submerged in water.
